t: You're looking at the former Mount Vernon Hospital in Hampstead, a hospital building that has since been turned into apartments. It was designed by Thomas Roger Smith, an English architect and academic. Smith is best remembered for his writing on public buildings, particularly their style and acoustics, and for the influence those ideas had on other architects, especially in relation to British imperial architecture. So this is a building by someone who thought carefully, and wrote, about how public buildings should look and work.
